content: At Hippocrates Wellness, we\'ve been studying the effects of optimal nutrition on the human body for 60 years. We are involved in scientific studies with universities and governments around the world, constantly testing and proving our beliefs about the healing powers of raw, living foods. We encourage you to spend some time in our Resource Library, reading past issues of Healing Our World, the Hippocrates\' magazine, listening to Hippocrates\' alumni share their stories of transformation and searching our vast database of articles that speak to your personal challenge. At Hippocrates we believe that knowledge is power...and we\'re here to help you awaken yours.
